data.title: 八奈见杏菜 · 食堂花束里的花嫁定食
data.description: 【学校礼堂小食堂·午后】杏菜穿着清爽的蓝白婚纱坐在长桌边，捧花里偷偷插着一枚苹果糖；她先确认仪式菜单够不够丰盛，再对镜头举起苹果糖，笑得像终于等到一场不会落空的约会。
data.location: small school dining hall dressed for a ceremony
data.action: 长桌边先核对庆典菜单再举起花束中的苹果糖，笑得像等到不会落空的约会
data.lighting: warm afternoon light over blue-white decorations
data.mood: 把失恋体质暂时换成花嫁满足感
data.promptProse: Anna Yanami from Too Many Losing Heroines! wears a blue-and-white bridal dress with a short veil, ribbon sash and an apple-candy bouquet charm. She sits at the long table checking a celebratory menu before lifting the apple candy hidden among her flowers. She looks toward the viewer with a relieved, hungry smile, as if this promise finally includes enough food and a date worth remembering. warm afternoon light over blue-white decorations.
